content:
The image shows a banana leaf with widespread yellowing across most of the leaf surface, with the central midrib visible. The yellowing appears uniform/diffuse rather than appearing as discrete streaks or spots with halos. There's some browning at the edges and minimal green remaining. This pattern of overall leaf yellowing without distinct lesion patterns is characteristic of Panama Disease (Fusarium wilt), which causes progressive yellowing of leaves starting from older leaves.
